prompts.featured: Use case: stylized-concept. Original MEE editorial illustration, tactile ceramic and cut-paper maquette, limestone, ivory #F7F6F2, cobalt #1547BB, vermilion #EF383E and restrained charcoal. Sophisticated gallery studio photography, directional soft light, precise shadows, bold thoughtful composition. No logos, readable words, numerals, flags, watermarks or real identifiable people. Conceptual, not a real document, measured chart or historical reconstruction. Wide cover1200:630: a cobalt ceramic justice balance hangs from several visible red and ivory threads held by anonymous sculptural hands near the top edge. The balance remains centered; ample negative space, no puppetry face, no national symbols. Visual question about how institutions are appointed, not an accusation of control.
